messages.subject: Problem with latest plyr version
messages.body_plain:
Hello!

After updating my plyr package I have problems using the extractModelSummaries command. I get the following error message:
"Error: All inputs to rbind.fill must be data.frames."

Do anyone know of a way to get around this problem?

Thanks!
Martin

messages.subject: Re: Problem with latest plyr version
messages.body_plain:
Hi Martin,

Sorry for the incompatibility with the plyr 1.8 update. I have fixed the rbind.fill bug -- and made the code more intelligent to boot! :) Anyway, we'll include this in the next official MplusAutomation release, but for now you can install the development version (which includes the fix) here:

install.packages("MplusAutomation", repos="http://R-Forge.R-project.org")

It may take 24 hours for R-forge to build the new package, but adding type="source" to the install line above should pull the latest. Let me know if you have any problems getting the fixed version.

Best,
Michael

messages.subject: Re: [MplusAutomation] Newbie problem reading residuals....
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

So the problem has to do with the text about Mplus diagrammer not be
parsed correctly.  A quick hack for now, manually delete this text
from the output file:

DIAGRAM INFORMATION
  Use View Diagram under the Diagram menu in the Mplus Editor to view
the diagram.
  If running Mplus from the Mplus Diagrammer, the diagram opens automatically.
  Diagram output
    c:\users\administrator\dropbox\erik_eric\ipm\cpiaceplusuniqueresidsonly.dgm

then it reads in just fine.  Hopefully I or Michael Hallquist can come
up with a patch for it in the near future.

Thanks for the example and report.

Cheers,

Josh

messages.subject: Re: [MplusAutomation] Newbie problem reading residuals....
messages.body_plain:
Hi Eric,

Thanks for letting us know about the bug in reading your output file. As Josh mentioned, we hadn't previously bumped into the DIAGRAM INFORMATION section in Mplus output, so the package inadvertently lumped this material into the RESIDUALS section (preceding), which caused the parser to crash in your case.

I have fixed the problem in the latest version of the package. We'll be releasing a more official update soon, but for now, you should be able to get the latest here:

install.packages("MplusAutomation", repos="http://R-Forge.R-project.org <http://r-forge.r-project.org/>", type="source")

Best wishes,
Michael
